title: Lift, Splat, Shoot: Encoding Images From Arbitrary Camera Rigs by Implicitly Unprojecting to 3D
grouping: No boxes or containers: four drawn stages in one row joined by short black arrows, each named by a plain caption underneath ('Per-Image CNN + Lift', 'Extrinsics + Splat', 'Bird's-Eye-View CNN').
shapes_depth: Input is a deck of camera photos offset diagonally with faint grey arrows behind it; the per-image network is a white wireframe frustum prism with 'xN' inside. The splat stage is a top-view yellow car icon ringed by six camera photos, each covered by a translucent blue triangular frustum fanning out from the car. The output is a stack of offset white square maps carrying sparse coloured segmentation strokes. Flat, thin black outlines, sans-serif captions.
proposed_highlight: Nothing is singled out; the contribution is carried by the middle illustration, the largest element, where the camera rig geometry (ego car, ring of views, blue frustums) stands in for a 'view transform' box.
lesson: Show the camera-to-BEV step as a top-view ego car ringed by its camera images, each under a translucent blue frustum fanning out from the car, so the rig geometry itself is the transform stage rather than a labelled box.
notes: Venue ECCV 2020 from the arXiv comment (venue_source: arxiv-journal-ref); year = that venue year. Element 'other' = the wireframe frustum prism standing for the per-image network. The whole figure is a single raster image in the PDF (refs crop recorded one embedded image covering the crop), so kb measure cannot separate photos from drawing: photo_share is null and the palette includes the embedded photos and renders.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: bird's-eye-view semantic segmentation from multi-camera images

core.what: four pictures in one left-to-right row joined by short black arrows: a stack of camera images, a lifted frustum, the six views splatted around a top-down car, a stack of bird's-eye-view output maps

relations.form: image stack, frustum glyph labelled 'xN', splat composite, BEV map stack, each with its step name ('Per-Image CNN + Lift', 'Extrinsics + Splat', 'Bird's-Eye-View CNN') as a caption underneath
the splat is drawn in the vehicle's own frame: six real camera images placed around a top-down car icon with translucent blue frustum wedges fanning out from it

channels.colour: translucent blue = camera frustums in the splat; orange, cyan and magenta marks in the BEV maps = predicted classes, unkeyed
channels.shape: photo stacks = per-camera inputs, wire-frame frustum = the lifted per-image volume, stacked white squares = BEV output channels
channels.line: four short black arrows, straight and aligned on the row's centre line

quality.strengths: The middle panel, which is the novel step, is the largest and shows the splat geometrically: real images in their true positions around the car with their frustums overlapping in the shared BEV plane.
quality.weaknesses: No networks are drawn; the step names are captions under pictures, so the CNNs are implied only by text; the output maps' colours are not keyed and the frustum glyph's 'xN' is the only hint that each image is lifted separately.

insights.structure: Four stages in a row with captions underneath: stacked camera photos, a wireframe frustum labeled xN, six photos arranged around a top-down car with blue camera frusta, and a stack of BEV output maps.
insights.data: Inputs are real multi-camera photos stacked with grey arrows, the lift is a line-drawn frustum, the splat is the car icon with photos at their mounting positions, outputs are white maps with coloured blobs.
insights.emphasis: The central splat panel is the largest and most colourful, with blue translucent frusta radiating from the car, making the camera-to-BEV projection the focal point.
insights.flow: Strictly left-to-right with plain black arrows between stages; captions under each stage name the operation.
insights.avoid: No module boxes or tensor shapes are given, so it conveys the idea but not the network; the frustum xN glyph is abstract.
